literal: Greatness those-who-possess will-perform in-the-proper-way rarity possessing deed.
translation: Those who possess greatness will perform difficult deeds in the proper way.
modern: பெருமை குணம் கொண்டவர்கள், மற்றவர்களால் செய்வதற்கு அரிய செயல்களை உரிய வழியில் செய்து முடிப்பார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet defines the nature of great people through their actions. While ordinary people might avoid difficult tasks, those with greatness take on rare and challenging deeds. Furthermore, they do not just attempt them, but successfully complete them in the proper way. The word 'ஆற்றின்' emphasizes that they follow the right method to achieve these extraordinary results.
